summary: Frontend-only end-to-end regression after backend refactor. Ran the complete admin first-run journey (Login → forced Reset → Onboarding 3-step wizard: Project→Inventory→Team → Dashboard), then admin functions (Projects edit, Users invite with temp password panel, logout), then invited accounts user first-login flow (login → forced reset → lands on /dashboard, not /onboarding). All 13 scenarios from the review request pass. The reported infinite-loop redirect fix in App.js Protected wrapper is verified — reset-password page renders correctly instead of redirecting in a loop.
test_report_links: /app/backend/tests/backend_test_iter5.py (unchanged, not re-run since backend test skipped per request)
critical_code_review_comments: Note (informational, not a bug): Dashboard's Shareable buttons for share-vendors/share-variance only render when data.top_vendors has entries or variance is computable. On a fresh install with no expenses, these testids are absent — expected but the review checklist assumed they render unconditionally.
Onboarding.jsx: total_units_planned and target_revenue kept as strings when user types (they only Number() at submit) — harmless but eslint may flag mixed-type state.

Users.jsx: DELETE /users/{user_id} performs a soft-deactivate (`is_active=false`) but the UI's toggleActive already reflects this correctly via Switch. No dedicated 'reset user password' admin endpoint exists — if an admin needs to reissue a temp password to a locked-out user, they currently have to delete + re-invite. Consider adding POST /api/users/{id}/reset-password.

Login form uses email.toLowerCase() before submit — good, but the invite form does not normalize emails before POST, so a user invited as 'Foo@X.com' can only log in with that exact case unless backend lowercases on lookup. Recommend either normalizing on invite or on backend user lookup for consistency.

rca_of_the_issue: Infinite-loop redirect bug was in Protected wrapper — it redirected users with must_reset_password=true to /reset-password even when they were already on that route, causing an endless <Navigate>. Fix (line 26 of App.js: `!window.location.pathname.startsWith('/reset-password')` guard) is confirmed working end-to-end: /reset-password renders the form, allows password change, and correctly navigates to /onboarding (admin) or /dashboard (non-admin) after refresh().
